name: DPM-2 Ancestral (flow / RF branch)
plain: The flow-model path of dpm_2_ancestral, picked automatically. The midpoint step itself is the VE-looking formula, but it is aimed at the RF σ_down and followed by the flow-style rescale and renoise.
math:
Symbols: x current latent; σ=sigmas[i]; σ'=sigmas[i+1]; D=denoised (x0 prediction after CFG); U=uncond_denoised; d=(x−D)/σ. 
RF step: ratio=1+(σ'/σ−1)η; σ_down=σ'·ratio; α'=1−σ'; α_down=1−σ_down; c=√(σ'²−σ_down²α'²/α_down²).
σ_m=exp(lerp(log σ, log σ_down, ½)); x₂=x+d(σ_m−σ); D₂ at σ_m; x_d=x+d₂(σ_down−σ); x'=(α'/α_down)x_d+n·s_noise·c. s_noise multiplied by noise_scale.

props.final_sigma0: Explicit: σ_down=0 (σ'=0) one Euler step equals D.
props.flow_const: This is the CONST path. The noise and rescale lines run for any η; at η=0, c=0 and the ratio is 1.
